name: MBSF Denominator File
description: Annual beneficiary-level MBSF denominator file containing beneficiary identifiers, geography, birth and death information, demographics, enrollment and coverage measures, entitlement reason codes, and derived Fee-for-Service, disabled, and age-65-plus indicators.

content.bene_id: VARCHAR: Encrypted Beneficiary ID (CCW Encrypted Beneficiary ID Number)
content.year: INTEGER: Reference year of enrollment data (Reference Year from MBSF)
content.age_65plus_ind: INTEGER: Age 65 or older indicator. Code values: 1 = age 65 or older, 0 = under age 65.
content.disabled_ind: INTEGER: Disability entitlement indicator. Code values: 1 = disability entitlement, 0 = no disability entitlement.
content.ffs65plus_ind: INTEGER: Fee-for-Service and age-65-plus indicator. Code values: 1 = Fee-for-Service eligible and age 65 or older, 0 = otherwise.
content.ffs_ind: INTEGER: Fee-for-Service eligibility indicator. Code values: 1 = Fee-for-Service eligible, 0 = enrolled in Medicare Advantage (HMO).
content.county: VARCHAR: County FIPS code mapped via https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_geoboundaries
content.state: VARCHAR: State code mapped via https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_geoboundaries and converted to state abbreviations
content.zcta: VARCHAR: ZIP Code Tabulation Area mapped using https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/zip2zcta_master_xwalk
content.age_dob: BIGINT: Age calculated as year of data - year of birth, truncated at 115
content.buyin: INTEGER: Buy-in status for Medicare A/B. Code values: 1 = any state buy-in months, 0 = none.
content.buyin_cvg_count: INTEGER: Number of months with state buy-in coverage
content.buyin_indicators: VARCHAR[]: Monthly Medicare A/B entitlement and buy-in status (12-month indicators)
content.curec: INTEGER: Current reason for Medicare entitlement. Code values: 0 = Old Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI), 1 = Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB), 2 = End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD), 3 = both DIB and ESRD.
content.dual: INTEGER: Dual eligibility status. Code values: 1 = dual eligible, 0 = not dual.
content.dual_cvg_count: INTEGER: Number of months with dual eligibility; NULL if no monthly record exists
content.dual_indicators: VARCHAR[]: Monthly dual eligibility indicators (12 months)
content.hmo: INTEGER: HMO enrollment status. Code values: 1 = enrolled in Medicare Advantage (HMO), 0 = not enrolled.
content.hmo_cvg_count: INTEGER: Number of months with HMO enrollment
content.hmo_indicators: VARCHAR[]: Monthly indicators of HMO (Medicare Advantage) enrollment (12-month indicators)
content.orec: INTEGER: Original reason for Medicare entitlement. Code values: 0 = Old Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI), 1 = Disability Insurance Benefits (DIB), 2 = End-stage Renal Disease (ESRD), 3 = both DIB and ESRD.
content.race: VARCHAR: SSA Beneficiary Race Code (Base). Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = White, 2 = Black, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = North American Native.
content.race_rti: VARCHAR: RTI-assigned enhanced race classification. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Non-Hispanic White, 2 = Black or African-American, 3 = Other, 4 = Asian/Pacific Islander, 5 = Hispanic, 6 = American Indian/Alaska Native.
content.sex: VARCHAR: Sex of the beneficiary. Code values: 0 = Unknown, 1 = Male, 2 = Female.
content.yob: BIGINT: Year of birth extracted from Date of Birth
